model_annotation: Figure 1 presents a bar chart titled "Abbildung 1 Entwicklung der Aluminium, Kupfer und Nickelimporte aus Russland." The chart displays the development of imports of aluminum, copper, and nickel from Russia over a series of years, specifically from 2023 to 2027. The horizontal axis represents the years, while the vertical axis indicates the quantity of imports, measured in unspecified units. Each bar represents a year, and the bars are color-coded to differentiate between the three commodities: aluminum, copper, and nickel. The chart shows a general trend of increasing imports for all three commodities over the given time period.
